<function name="PlayerEnteredVehicle" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<description>
Called when a player enters a vehicle.

Called just after <page>GM:CanPlayerEnterVehicle</page>.

See also <page>GM:PlayerLeaveVehicle</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">Player who entered vehicle.</arg>
		<arg name="veh" type="Vehicle">Vehicle the player entered.</arg>
		<arg name="role" type="number">The seat number.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
